correctness.rationale: All-period equal-firing counts and confined complement are derived or supported by primary lemmas. The one-firing predecessor phase count and explicit necessary condition for central adjacent firing prove every multiplicity for q=3 and q=4. The standalone checker separately exhausts literal vertex configurations for m=1..6 and weighted firing words through m=25; finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
